THE KING'S LANDING HERALD (a made-up publication for the tests)
Published by Petyr Baelish for House BAELISH, March 1547.

Lord Eddard Stark, Hand of the King, rode into Kelso this month and
granted lands to the Night's Watch. It is said that Lord Stannis
Baratheon has taken Dragonstone. House BAELISH denies that Lord Petyr
Baelish holds the Magistracy of Harrenhal.

Our factors report that the market at Kelso buys horses for 120 ducats.
